title: Domain Modeling Made Functional - Scott Wlaschin - KanDDDinsky 2019
summary: Scott Wlaschin shows how statically typed functional languages, using F# examples, can model a business domain so that invalid states cannot be represented. The type system acts almost like an instant unit test at compile time.
why: HN treats it as the canonical, approachable example of domain-driven design with types and 'make invalid states unrepresentable'.

quote.text: this talk opened my eyes to the power of f# philosophy and type system
